formula: Score = 100 × (0.40 × reach + 0.30 × severity + 0.15 × stage fit + 0.15 × segment fit)

definitions.reach: the opportunity's problem posts divided by the largest opportunity's
definitions.severity: share of its posts stating an event that report stopping, pausing, reducing or considering stopping
definitions.stage_fit: share of its posts stating a stage that sit in the first 12 months (onboarding to months 7–12)
definitions.segment_fit: share of its posts stating experience that come from first-time investors
